w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Redactor is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: The Focus Group stops at the boundary — pacing, unwilling. Something else is already here. It's still out there.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (The Redactor, The Terms of Service, The Ugly Beast, Spool) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Chorus Line.

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

Ivy won't meet your eye. You said you'd help with the pantry run — and it never happened. Promises rot. (-15 trust)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (18/11/7), with 2 wave-4 fought, 9 contests survived, 5 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — David Kim ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store has fallen far from its recent high again — the shelves are nearly bare.
